items: The fastest-growing quick-service brands build on one hero product and a limited menu, which makes training, consistency and storytelling easier as they scale.
They franchise with discipline, keeping tight control of branding, technology and franchisee selection so quality holds as unit counts grow.
Loyalty works as a core platform: invest in owned channels such as your app, SMS and loyalty program so repeat orders come through systems you control.
Treat every part of the store, from packaging to music to how well your app works, as part of the brand guests share online.
Audit your menu, simplify the store and ask whether anyone would share your product online without being paid.
